links.outcome: Presence of confabulations and clinical judgment weaknesses in LLM responses to regional anesthesia scenarios
links.effect: All four platforms showed weaknesses in clinical judgment, thoroughness, and rationale, more pronounced for the complex scenario; evidence of confabulations in the responses.
links.quote: There is evidence of confabulations in the responses.

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy, clinical judgment, and hallucinations of four LLM chatbots across basic and complex regional anesthesia clinical scenarios without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
